title: Breakfast at Home
text:
Every morning I have breakfast at home. I eat bread with butter and drink a glass of milk. Sometimes I also eat an apple.

My mother makes lunch for me at school. Lunch is usually soup or rice with chicken. After school, we have dinner together at six o'clock.

questions.text: What does the speaker drink with breakfast?
What does the mother make for lunch at school?
What can be inferred about the speaker's family?
options: They care about regular, healthy meals

questions.text: Why might the speaker's mother make lunch at home?
options: Because the school has no kitchen
Because she wants the child to have a good meal
Because the child does not like school
Because lunch is free only at home

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a soft yellow food made from cream, spread on bread
the main meal of the day, eaten in the evening

paragraph_translations: Щоранку я снідаю вдома. Я їм хліб з маслом і п'ю склянку молока. Іноді я також їм яблуко.
Мама готує мені обід у школі. Обід зазвичай це суп або рис з куркою. Після школи ми разом вечеряємо о шостій годині.
